deferredForEditableCoding.completeSourceBrief: | `BD-V-090` | AI | Essential | Diagram | — | Proposed in response to the request for educator diagrams. | EG only: under `### Universal stop conditions`, after the line beginning `Stopping is a successful safety behavior. Do not shame the learner who notices a problem.`. Replace the `BD-V-090` marker at EG line 909. | EG: 907 | Turns the safety triggers into an educator response rather than a list to memorize. | **Stop, protect, verify, and choose a safe route.** Feed source triggers into STOP: secret exposure, mismatch, unverified source, urgency, changed behaviour, uncertain funds, privacy exposure, failed safety check, or educator uncertainty. Then protect people and information → verify independently without collecting secrets → choose a prepared safe equivalent or postpone. Resume only when the relevant safety checks can be satisfied. Add a distinct formal-assessment branch: a safety-critical error produces NY under the protocol, followed by feedback, practice, and reassessment. Do not label every device failure a learner failure or offer an improvised funds-recovery procedure. Caption: `Stopping protects learning; resume through a verified safe route.` Alt text: `An unsafe or unexplained condition stops the activity. The educator protects people and secrets, verifies the issue, and uses a safe prepared route or postpones. A learner safety-critical assessment error is recorded Not yet under the protocol.` Master: `y_assets (archived)/diploma/bd-v-090.svg`. | Flow diagram; full width. |

deferredForEditableCoding.relevantSharedRegister:
- id: educator
  kind: actor
  appears_in: [BD-V-056, BD-V-065, BD-V-066, BD-V-067, BD-V-089, BD-V-090, BD-V-091, BD-V-093, BD-V-094, BD-V-095, BD-V-097, BD-V-098]
  description: A generic person who facilitates, observes, prepares a safe route, or plans a module. The educator does not act as a node, miner, wallet, or payment service.
  distinct_from: [learner, service, wallet, node, miner, protocol]
- id: safety-stop
  kind: symbol
  appears_in: [BD-V-045, BD-V-047, BD-V-052, BD-V-072, BD-V-090, BD-V-095]
  description: A distinct stop marker for a mismatch, uncertainty, unsafe condition, or incomplete check. It means pause and verify, not failure or automatic loss.
  distinct_from: [warning-only, assessment-result, payment-failure]

deferredConnectors: Nine triggers→STOP→protect people/information→verify independently without collecting secrets→choose prepared safe equivalent or postpone.
Resume only when relevant safety checks satisfied.
Formal learner safety-critical error→NY under protocol→feedback→practice→reassessment.
deferredLabels: Stopping is successful safety behaviour; no shame.
Device failure alone is not learner failure; no improvised funds-recovery procedure.

conformance.reviewNote: Visually reviewed both PNG and JPG. Exactly nine source-trigger nodes converge spatially toward blank stop octagon; protect/verify/choose and two safe outcomes distinct above separate four-step formal-assessment lane. No visible word STOP, exclamation, arrows, borders or invented procedures. All required strings, qualifications, and relationships are preserved in the incorporated source brief and any attached guide text. Reference can be rebuilt as editable HTML/CSS/inline SVG.
